name: Carnivore diet breath

card.summary: Reports of bad breath on an all-meat diet; the idea is discussed, but no studies on carnivore breath specifically exist.
card.note: Persistent bad breath can have dental or medical causes.

lead: Carnivore diet breath is the unusual or unpleasant breath odor that some people report when they eat only animal products, a pattern known as the carnivore or zero-carb diet. It matters to people who adopt the diet for leaner, more muscular looks or clearer skin and who want to manage how they come across socially, so it is discussed alongside oral care and grooming. [1][2]

The carnivore diet is a high-protein, low-carbohydrate diet that excludes plant foods, with stricter versions such as the lion diet limited to beef, salt and water. Prominent promoters named by Wikipedia include Shawn Baker, Jordan and Mikhaila Peterson and Paul Saladino. [1] Wikipedia's ketosis article says breath can take on a sweet, fruity note from acetone, a ketone body that is exhaled, and lists this among effects of switching to a ketogenic or low-carbohydrate diet. [3]

Wikipedia's halitosis article attributes most bad breath to bacteria on the back of the tongue breaking down proteins, and lists fasting among less common causes; it names acetone and ketoacidosis in connection with fruity odor. [4] No published clinical study has measured breath specifically in people eating a carnivore diet.

chain: Very low-carbohydrate eating can produce ketones such as acetone
Acetone is exhaled and can give breath a fruity note
Breath care keeps the diet's other benefits socially comfortable
angle.text: People who eat carnivore for physique or skin goals discuss breath as a trade-off to manage, since breath odor affects how close contact feels. Oral hygiene measures such as tongue cleaning are the ones dental sources describe for halitosis in general.

infobox: None found specific to carnivore diets

paras: The carnivore diet permits animal products such as meat, dairy and eggs and excludes plant foods. Wikipedia describes variants including the lion diet and an animal-based diet that adds fruit, honey and raw dairy. [1] Historical roots it lists include Bernard Moncriff in 1856, Arnaldo Cantani in the 1870s and James H. Salisbury in the 1880s. [1]

Nutrition bodies including the British Dietetic Association and Dietitians Australia dismiss the diet as an extreme fad, and the article lists raised LDL cholesterol, micronutrient gaps, low fiber and kidney concerns among expert objections. It does not discuss breath. [1]

Ketosis produces acetone, which is exhaled, and Wikipedia notes that breath ketone levels can be measured. [3] Halitosis in general stems mostly from oral bacteria, and acetone is linked to a fruity odor in conditions such as diabetes and ketoacidosis. [4]
Some people who eat very low-carbohydrate diets attribute breath changes to ketosis. Whether this applies to carnivore eating specifically has not been established in published studies.

Guidance for halitosis includes brushing, flossing, tongue cleaning, antimicrobial mouthwash and treating gum disease or decay, and the article states that evidence does not support dietary changes or chewing gum as treatments. [4] Chronic bad breath affects an estimated 25 percent of people to varying degrees. [4]

timeline.event: Bernard Moncriff described as an early proponent of an all-meat diet. [1]
Shawn Baker begins promoting the carnivore diet on social media. [1]

quick.overview:
Carnivore diet breath is the bad breath some people report when eating only animal products. It is mentioned in discussions of the diet and of keto-style eating.

No clinical studies were found that measure breath on a carnivore diet.
quick.mechanism: Reference sources link acetone from ketosis to a fruity breath odour, but oral causes such as tongue coating and gum disease are the most common cause of halitosis in general.
quick.risks: The odour itself is not described as harmful. Dentists and physicians advise evaluation when bad breath persists, since gum disease, decay or conditions such as diabetes can be causes.
